CLICKHOUSE_USER.description: ClickHouse username. Referenced by Langfuse as ${{clickhouse.CLICKHOUSE_USER}}.

CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD.description: ClickHouse password. Auto-generated at deploy time. Referenced by Langfuse as ${{clickhouse.CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD}}.

CLICKHOUSE_DB.description: Default ClickHouse database. Langfuse uses this for analytics data.

CLICKHOUSE_PORT.description: ClickHouse native protocol port. Langfuse migration URL uses this port via private networking.

CLICKHOUSE_HTTP_PORT.description: ClickHouse HTTP port. Langfuse CLICKHOUSE_URL references this port via private networking.
